statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r[0] and r[1] are defined and the following holds. Let b be the strictly increasing rearrangement of stones. Define M = max { j-i+1 | 0 <= i <= j < n and b[j]-b[i] < n }. Define m = 0 if b[n-1]-b[0] = n-1; otherwise m = 1 if b[n-1]-b[1] = n-1 or b[n-2]-b[0] = n-1; otherwise m = max(2, n-M). Define E = b[n-1]-b[0]+1-n, L = b[1]-b[0]-1, R = b[n-1]-b[n-2]-1, and Mx = E - min(L,R). Then r[0] = m and r[1] = Mx.
preconditions: Let n = len(stones). Assume 3 <= n <= 10000, all entries of stones are distinct, and 1 <= stones[i] <= 10^9 for every 0 <= i < n.
